reviews.text: Special pet grooming salon.

Perfect experience! I was recommended by a family member. I took my dog ​​in July, and I loved the care the girl gave her. She's lovely. When I picked her up, my dog ​​looked absolutely gorgeous; she made her look stunning. Plus, the girl was super punctual, both for the appointment and for picking her up. I'll definitely be back. Highly recommended!
I just took Croqueta, our Pomeranian, and he looks so handsome we can't believe it! Thank you, Esther, you're the best! ❤️

Esther is fantastic and very professional. I took my older dog, Bela, to her, and she treated her with great care. She stayed as long as needed, and the price was very reasonable.

Thank you, Esther.
Noa looked so beautiful! The service was very professional and friendly, with no rush and lots of care.
Yes, I saw that. They wouldn't take my husky that only needed bathing. But I'll contact you soon to ask. I need one for my husky/Belgian Shepherd mix. Thanks!
I've known Esther for a few years now; she bathes and grooms my cat Kitty, and I'm delighted! She's wonderful and leaves my cat looking gorgeous. I highly recommend her!
Highly recommended, excellent service and my furry friend looks gorgeous!
I took my kitten there the other day and the experience was amazing; she did a fantastic job. Esther is a wonderful person; you can tell she loves her work. I highly recommend this place.
Friendly and professional service! Above all, they love animals! 100% recommended!

Esther has won the heart of my stubborn, furry son Lucas, as well as my complete trust. Fantastic service and attention. I'll be back! Thank you so much for your excellent work. We're so glad we found you. My dog ​​is a bit particular, but you've earned it!
Brilliant
I took my two cats to her and she did an amazing job! She was so gentle and patient with them, and they absolutely loved her
Everything was great...my Roki has a very peculiar character and the only groomer he behaves well at is here...Thank you so much for your service...You're a delight

I took my dog ​​there for the first time, a little worried. He's older, 16 years old, and has a bandaged wound on his side, so they only needed to shave the areas not covered by the bandage. I was delighted; they were super professional and very gentle with the dog. 100% recommended, I'll definitely be back.

I left my dog ​​with Esther one day when I had to be in Tavernes, and because she had such great reviews. Since then, I've been coming from Paterna to Tavernes to have her pampered. My dog ​​is 16 years old and needs lots of cuddles, and when my Chika sees her, she runs to greet her excitedly. That only happens when she feels comfortable... and that's priceless. Knowing your furry friend is in good hands.
I recommend her 200%! 🥰 Thank you, Esther! ♥️

Dexter's dog grooming salon has one of the best professional dog groomers I've ever met. She always makes our dogs look their best. She takes great care of them and is very patient. I truly recommend this place without hesitation.

Perfect place to take your pet to the groomer. I've been going for many years and now with Esther we're just as happy. I take two cats and she's very kind, and even if they have complicated mats, she's very professional and leaves them looking perfect. ☺️

Esther is a great professional. She's polite, cheerful, and if the dog or any other pet is a little mischievous, she always shows patience and knows how to stay calm, which really helps our pets feel safe and secure with her.

Esther is a true professional. From the very first moment, she inspires confidence, warmth, and a wealth of experience with animals. Her service was excellent, very careful and respectful, and the final result was wonderful. It's clear she loves what she does and pays attention to every detail.
Without a doubt, I wholeheartedly recommend her. Five stars, more than well-deserved.
If anyone is considering it, don't hesitate. Your pet will be in the best hands here.
Esther, I'll say the same thing about you again. I've been around you and I stand by what I said. You're a true professional for me and my furry friend.

Esther is punctual and provides a very professional service. You can tell how much she loves animals; she always leaves my dog ​​looking even more handsome than when he first arrives, with perfectly trimmed nails and fur, and happy. He feels very comfortable with her. I came all the way from Casinos; I heard wonderful things about her, and this is my third time visiting. Thank you again. Happy holidays!
We took Boby, our fluffy collie, and in no time they made him look great and feel refreshed. They even gave him a treat when they were finished. We'll definitely be back.

The owner has an incredible way with animals. I took Kapi, my cat who is terrified of water, and he relaxed so much while they were cleaning and trimming his nails that he seemed like a completely different cat.
My boys were so happy during their visit with Esther. The pampering and kind treatment really showed, as did her excellent work in the bath and grooming. THANK YOU SO MUCH!!! …
Friendly and professional staff
Excellent place to get your pet's hair cut 🐕 …
Everything was perfect, professionals.

Thank you so much for your review, Elisa! 😊 We're so glad you had a great experience. We hope to see you again soon!
Best regards,
Esther …
Machine everything
